findings.title: NPE when the all-clients resource is missing in per-client permission check
findings.body: In hasPermission(ClientModel, String), if no per-client resource exists the code loads the 'Clients' type resource via getResourceTypeResource(...) and immediately calls authz.getStoreFactory().getPolicyStore().findByResource(server, resource) without a null check. getResourceTypeResource returns null when the type resource has not been created (for example on a realm whose admin-permissions client was set up before the Clients type existed, or if the resource was removed). The result is a NullPointerException on every admin client-level check instead of a clean 'no permission' answer. A null check on the resource returning false should be added.

findings.title: isPermissionsEnabled/setPermissionsEnabled throw in V2 but are still called on V2 paths
findings.body: ClientPermissionsV2 overrides isPermissionsEnabled and setPermissionsEnabled to throw UnsupportedOperationException. AdminPermissions.registerListener still calls management(...).clients().setPermissionsEnabled(client, false) on ClientRemovedEvent whenever the ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ feature is enabled. When the V2 evaluator is in use (ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ_V2 enabled alongside the v1 flag), deleting any client will throw from the event listener. The listener needs to avoid the V2 evaluator or V2 needs a no-op/supported implementation.

findings.title: Unused private method and imports left in new class
findings.body: getEvaluationContext(...) is private and never called, and the imports for Scope, the static TOKEN_EXCHANGE, and the logger field are unused. This is dead code in a newly added file that will be flagged by checkstyle or confuse maintainers about whether token-exchange evaluation is supported in V2.

findings.title: requireView() javadoc describes the wrong behavior
findings.body: The javadoc for requireView() says 'Returns true if canView() returns true', but the method is void and throws ForbiddenException when the check fails. The same copy-paste error appears for requireViewClientScopes() at line 101-102, which says it returns true. Callers relying on the docs would expect a boolean.
